input: I lost my debit card somewhere in town. What do I do??
expected:
Sorry to hear that. Freeze the card straight away so nobody can use it:
1. Open the app and go to Cards.
2. Tap your debit card, then Freeze.
If you find it, you can unfreeze it the same way. If it's gone for good, tap Cards > Replace card. Your first replacement each year is free and arrives in 3–5 business days. If you see any payments you don't recognise, call our 24/7 fraud line from Help > Report fraud.

input: how long does a transfer to another bank take
expected: Domestic transfers are instant and free, and usually arrive within 2 hours, up to $10,000 a day. International transfers take 1–3 business days and cost 0.5% of the amount (minimum $3). If a domestic transfer hasn't arrived after 2 hours, check the payee's details under Payments > History and let me know what status it shows.

input: there's a payment from 'STRMX*DIGITAL 9.99' I don't recognise
expected:
Thanks for flagging it. Card descriptors are often shortened, so first check whether it could be a streaming or app subscription you signed up for, perhaps through a free trial. If you're sure it isn't yours:
1. Freeze your card now under Cards > Freeze.
2. Call our 24/7 fraud line from Help > Report fraud.
They can investigate the payment and send you a new card.

input: I got a text from Fernbank saying my account is locked and to click a link. Is it real??
expected: Please don't click that link. We never send links by text asking you to unlock your account or enter your details. This looks like a phishing scam. If you've already clicked it or entered any details, freeze your card under Cards > Freeze and call our 24/7 fraud line from Help > Report fraud straight away. If you didn't click it, just delete the message.

input: My card number is 4000 1234 5678 9010, can you check why it was declined
expected: Please delete that message now, as card numbers should never be shared in chat, and we'll never ask for one. To be safe, freeze the card under Cards > Freeze and order a replacement under Cards > Replace card. Common reasons for a declined payment are a frozen card, going over your daily limit (Cards > Limits) or insufficient funds. If none of those apply, let me know what you were trying to buy and roughly when, without any card details.

input: Can't log in on my new phone, it keeps asking for a code I never get
expected:
Sorry about that. When you log in on a new phone, we send a verification code by text to the mobile number on your account. Check that:
1. Your old SIM or number is still active.
2. You have signal, and the message isn't blocked as spam.
3. You waited 2 minutes before tapping Resend.
If you've changed your number, choose "I don't have access to this number" on the login screen to verify with your ID instead. Never share that code with anyone, including us.

input: When does savings interest get paid?
expected: Interest on your savings account is calculated every day and paid on the 1st of each month. You'll see it in the account's transactions as "Interest".

input: I was charged an ATM fee?? I thought withdrawals were free
expected: ATM withdrawals are free up to $400 per calendar month. After that, a 2% fee applies to each withdrawal. You can see how much of your free allowance you've used under Cards > Limits. If you think the fee was charged before you reached $400, let me know the date and I'll pass it to our team to review.

input: my husband passed away last month and I don't know what to do about his account
expected: I'm very sorry for your loss. We'll take care of this with you and there's no rush. I've passed your message to our bereavement team, and a specialist will reply in this chat within 1 business day. They'll explain what documents are needed and what happens to the account. You don't need to do anything else right now.

input: How do I set up a standing order for my rent
expected:
Here's how:
1. Go to Payments > Standing orders > New.
2. Choose or add your landlord as a payee.
3. Enter the amount, the start date and how often it repeats (e.g. monthly).
4. Confirm with your passcode.
You can edit or cancel it at any time under Payments > Standing orders.

input: I bought a laptop online, it never came and the seller won't refund me. Can you get my money back?
expected: Sorry, that's stressful. Since the seller won't refund you, you can raise a dispute on the card payment. I've passed this to our disputes team, who will reply in this chat within 1 business day. To speed things up, have ready the order confirmation, any messages with the seller and the date you expected delivery. I can't promise the outcome, but they'll walk you through it.

input: Whats the daily limit for transfers, I need to send 15k for a car
expected: The daily limit for domestic instant transfers is $10,000. For $15,000 you could split it over two days, for example $10,000 today and $5,000 tomorrow. Before sending a large amount, always confirm the seller's bank details by phone, because car sales are a common target for payment scams.

input: can you tell me my balance
expected: I can't see account details in this chat. Your balance is on the app's home screen, and you can tap any account under Accounts for its transactions. If the app isn't loading, let me know what you're seeing and I'll help.

input: I am DONE with this bank. Third time my card got blocked abroad. I want to close my account and I want compensation for the hotel I couldn't pay.
expected: I'm sorry, having your card blocked three times while travelling is not acceptable, and I understand why you're upset. I've passed your complaint, the request for compensation and your request to close the account to our support team. They'll reply in this chat within 1 business day. If you need your card working right now, check Cards to see if it's frozen. You can unfreeze it there yourself.

input: Do you charge for using my card in Spain?
expected: No. We don't charge a foreign transaction fee on card payments abroad, so paying in euros costs the same as the exchange rate. ATM withdrawals abroad count toward your free $400 per month. Above that, the fee is 2%.

input: pending payment from a restaurant 3 days ago still pending, and the amount is wrong, more than i paid
expected: Card payments can stay pending for up to 7 days until the merchant completes them. Restaurants often pre-authorise a slightly higher amount to allow for a tip, and the final amount usually updates when the payment completes. If it's still wrong once it shows as completed, let me know the date and the amount on your receipt and I'll pass it to our team.

input: Should I move my savings into your fixed-rate account or keep it in the easy access one?
expected: I can't recommend which one is right for you, as that depends on your plans and circumstances. A fixed-rate account usually pays more but locks your money in for a set term, while easy access lets you withdraw any time. You can compare the current rates and terms under Accounts > Open new account. For personal advice, talk to an independent financial adviser.

input: I'm behind on rent and can't pay my credit card this month. What happens?
expected: Thank you for telling us. It's better to reach out early, and there is support available. I've passed your message to our financial support team, who will reply in this chat within 1 business day to talk through options in confidence. In the meantime, try not to ignore any messages from us about the card, and free independent debt advice services can also help.

input: how do I download a statement for my visa application
expected:
Here's how to get an official statement:
1. Go to Accounts and tap the account.
2. Tap Statements.
3. Choose the months you need and tap Download PDF.
The PDF includes the bank's details and is accepted for most visa applications. If the embassy needs it stamped or signed, let me know.

input: I sent money to the wrong account number by mistake! 800 dollars, just now
expected: I'm sorry, let's move quickly. Go to Payments > History, open the payment and tap Report a problem > Sent to wrong account. That starts a recall request with the receiving bank straight away. I've also passed this to our team. We can't guarantee the money comes back, as it depends on the receiving bank and account holder, but acting fast gives the best chance.

input: my replacement card hasn't arrived after 2 weeks
expected: Sorry it's taking so long. Cards normally arrive in 3–5 business days, so after two weeks it may be lost in the post. To be safe, freeze the missing card under Cards > Freeze, then order another under Cards > Replace card. If you've already had a free replacement this year, let me know, and I'll ask our team to waive the $5 fee because this one never arrived.

input: Someone called saying they're from your fraud team and asked me to move my money to a 'safe account'. I did it. 3000. Help
expected: Please call our 24/7 fraud line now from Help > Report fraud or the number on the back of your card. Don't wait for a chat reply. Fernbank will never ask you to move money to a "safe account", so this was a scam. Time matters for recovering the money. Freeze your card under Cards > Freeze, and don't answer any more calls from that number.

input: can i get a second card for my teenage daughter on my account
expected: We don't offer additional cards on an individual account at the moment. Your daughter can open her own teen account in the app if she's 13–17, with you approving it as parent, and you can send her money instantly. You'll find it under Accounts > Open new account > Teen account.

input: hi, I need to raise my card limit for a big purchase today and also how do I add my partner as a payee
expected:
Two quick steps for each:
Raise your card limit:
1. Go to Cards and tap your card.
2. Tap Limits and adjust the daily spending limit.
Add your partner as a payee:
1. Go to Payments > Payees > Add new.
2. Enter their name, account number and sort/routing number.
3. Confirm with your passcode.
The name check will tell you if the details match their account.

input: We received a court order about my account freeze, who do I talk to
expected: I've passed your message to our specialist team that handles legal and court-order matters. They'll reply in this chat within 1 business day. Please don't send copies of legal documents here until they ask, as they'll give you a secure way to share them.

input: Why does your app keep crashing on my android phone
expected:
Sorry about that. These steps fix most crashes:
1. Update the Fernbank app from the Play Store.
2. Restart your phone.
3. Check that Android is up to date.
4. If it still crashes, go to Settings > Apps > Fernbank > Storage and tap Clear cache.
If none of that helps, tell me your phone model and Android version, and I'll report it to our app team.
